source: Owner-approved mockup 'Showing the work' (2026-11-17): the 29 member-visible items and the member-facing figures. Behind-the-scenes rows, the update-run count and the files/lines line are left out by the 2026-11-06 rule.

items.title: Stories we couldn't open still reach your feed
items.detail: They show up with a note saying the full text couldn't be loaded.

items.title: New accounts can send 50 letters a day for their first 3 days
items.detail: A starting allowance that keeps brand-new accounts from being misused.

items.title: A bill that became law no longer reads "Dead"
items.detail: Enacted bills keep their final status even when a later sync says otherwise.

items.title: Automatic bill updates share one thread per state
items.detail: Instead of a new thread for every bill.

items.title: Lounge links outside our trusted list wait for a moderator
items.detail: Links to well-known sites post at once.

items.title: Write to reporters and researchers
items.detail: Reply to a story's or study's author at the address they published.

items.title: Your letter gets its own subject line
items.detail: Officials no longer see the same subject from everyone.

items.title: The Lounge's new-message counter clears once you've seen the chat
Edit or delete your own posts
items.detail: Group leaders can hide posts in their group.

items.title: Members' posts show ahead of automatic bill updates
Image posts and edits in groups
items.detail: Images only your group can see, and group stats that count from the day you joined.

items.title: A story with no text shows its headline
items.detail: Not a computer-written guess at what it says.

items.title: New officials count as not yet written
items.detail: A campaign shows you who still needs your letter after someone new takes office.

items.title: Bills from past sessions say so
items.detail: Instead of looking like they're still moving.

items.title: Confirmation links work in any browser or mail app
items.detail: They sign you straight in.

items.title: A new bill no longer lands on an old bill's page
items.detail: When a state reuses a bill number, the two stay separate.

items.title: Your profile explains why others see you as "Member"
items.detail: And how to change it.

items.title: We can reply to your feedback
items.detail: Replies arrive in your notifications and on your Your feedback page.

items.title: Legislator pages load faster
Group posts hold 10,000 characters
items.detail: And members no longer see a Join button on Connect.

items.title: News, bill, alert and meeting pages load faster
Fresher contact details for state legislators
items.detail: Email, phone and office address refresh from official sources.

items.title: Stalled bills stop reading "Advancing fast"
items.detail: And actions from the same day show in order.

items.title: Mission patches awarded; resend after an address fix
items.detail: Patches you'd already earned were added.

items.title: One-click sending finishes even if you leave the page
Election results cover more races
items.detail: U.S. Senate races, Minnesota, Indiana and Florida.

items.title: State bills stay off your local pending measures
Pages start faster when you're not signed in
Votes show every legislator by name
items.detail: Each roll-call vote lists how each legislator voted and links to their page.
